description: A 60 MW wind farm and a 50 MWp PV plant with an optional battery behind one 70 MW grid connection. Size the battery and weigh PPA against merchant revenue on an illustrative day-ahead price over a full hourly 2030. Generation-only; financial PPAs and a 25-year investment case.

ledger.note: the example is built for 2030 (native horizon until free planning years, E1)

study_notes: One hourly year: the battery is sized against the day-ahead price and the curtailment it can recover at the export limit.
The PPAs settle after the solve, so they never change the battery the plan picks.
The default price is illustrative; two observed 2024 years ship beside it. Bring your own series before relying on a result.
